s.n: Trooper's bully beef rissoles with tomato relish
s.note: Bully beef from the ration tin, the troopers' standby on the ride to Beersheba
s.how: Corned beef rissoles with potato, onion and parsley, fried crisp and served with tomato relish. Boil 500g peeled potatoes until tender and mash. Mix with 340g tinned corned beef, 1 grated onion, a handful of chopped parsley, 1 egg and plenty of pepper. Shape into 12 small rissoles, roll in 60g dried breadcrumbs and fry in 3 tbsp oil for 4 minutes a side until crisp. Serve hot with 150g tomato relish.

s.n: Beersheba camp damper with honey butter
s.note: Round damper loaf served warm with honey butter
s.how: Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 300ml milk to a soft dough and knead briefly. Shape into a round, cut a cross on top and dust with flour. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow when tapped. Whip 100g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of sea salt. Serve the damper warm with the honey butter.

m.n: Light horse camp beef and stout stew
m.note: Chuck beef, carrot and onion slow-cooked in stout
m.how: Toss 1kg diced chuck in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in oil. Add 2 diced onions, 3 carrots and 2 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 375ml stout, 500ml beef stock, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Spoon the stew over the mash.

w.note: Soft dumplings poached in golden syrup sauce
w.how: Rub 50g butter into 200g self-raising flour, then stir in 1 egg and 80ml milk to a soft dough. In a wide pan, bring 250ml water, 125ml golden syrup, 80g brown sugar, 30g butter and a squeeze of lemon to the boil. Drop in tablespoons of dough, cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes without lifting the lid. Serve in bowls with the sauce and 200ml thick cream.

d.note: Strong black tea sweetened with condensed milk
d.how: Bring 1.2L water to the boil in a billy or saucepan. Add 6 black tea bags, take off the heat and steep 5 minutes for a strong brew. Remove the bags. Spoon 1 to 2 tbsp condensed milk into each of 4 enamel mugs, pour over the hot tea and stir until creamy.
